I, with the Sun existing in Aries, would rather have predicted this same thing, than in Scorpio, on account of the Sun's exaltation in Aries.

summary.headline: Judgments for the Sun’s Houses
summary.text: Judgments for the Sun in the houses of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus, distinguishing diurnal and nocturnal nativities and describing character, fortune, parents, health, wealth, and relations with nobles.
